feature: A tutorial's ring takes the shape of the control it is round
summary: The highlight ring a guide draws is no longer always the same rounded box. It now takes the shape of the thing it is round: a pill on the floating tool bar, a circle on a round tool button, and the squarer corner it always had on a run of panel rows.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next. Help menu, Take the Tour. Nothing to switch on.

try.do: Choose Help, then Take the Tour.
Look at step one: the ring is round the floating tool bar.
Press Next and look at step two: the ring is round the Measure button.
Press I to pick Measure for real, and look at step three: the ring is round the Layers list.
Press Back twice and forward twice, watching the ring change shape as it moves.

evaluate: Does the ring round the tool bar now read as the bar itself rather than a box parked over it?
On the Measure button, is the circle the right distance out, or is it tight enough to look like part of the button?
Round the Layers list, is the 10pt corner still right, or should a run of panel rows ring squarer than that?
When a step moves from the bar to a panel section, does the ring changing shape read as one ring moving, or as two different rings?
rough: The Mac's screen was locked for this whole task, so macOS would not draw the app and no walk could run: there is no photograph of the real window here. The picture is an offscreen render of the shipping ring code drawn round stand-ins of the three controls, so the shapes are the real ones but the surroundings are not. A sweep has been asked for so the tutorial walks run once the screen is unlocked.

The tool bar anchor covers the tools capsule AND the small settings capsules beside it, with a gap between them, so one pill rings the pair rather than each. It is much closer than the old box, but on a wide window the ring crosses a gap.

The ring's distance from the control is still one number for everything (5pt). On the 28pt tool button that reads tight and deliberate; round the whole docked panel it is barely visible against the window edge.
